prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original static reward panorama for RevealLine, Ukraine Atlas / Fracture Lines. It must feel emotionally generous as a fully revealed reward and retain recognizable big shapes behind partial concealment. Scene: an imagined Ukrainian foothill churchyard at blue hour, seen from a slightly elevated hillside so the whole low, weathered ring of stone and timber enclosure is readable across the middle ground. Four offset openings interrupt the irregular oval perimeter; their worn footpaths suggest leaving and returning without becoming a diagram. Inside stands a modest Ukrainian timber tserkva built of dark horizontal logs on a stone base, with layered wooden-shingle roofs and restrained cupolas; a separate small wooden bell tower marks one gateway. Keep the architecture regionally grounded, with no towering fantasy spires. An old pear tree and a simple stone well soften the enclosure; two tiny people in everyday linen and wool clothing return through the near gate carrying a basket. Their faces remain subordinate to the landscape. Foreground grasses and a folded red-and-ivory geometric cloth over a gate rail, warm amber windows against deep indigo shadows, silver mist beyond rolling wooded hills, and a last pale rose strip of sky. Quiet memory, shelter and homecoming. Use the four openings and encircling wall as a visual echo of Split Ring, not exact authored gate positions. Invent the church and cloth entirely; do not copy a named monument, artist, maker's pattern or ceremonial symbol.
